title: Forgejo CI Pipelines
description: Status, duration, and failure analysis for Forgejo Actions pipelines collected by kxn. Backed by the pipeline_runs, pipeline_jobs and pipeline_logs tables that kxn save writes to Postgres.

list.name: repo
list.label: Repository
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo FROM pipeline_runs ORDER BY repo

list.name: workflow
list.label: Workflow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workflow_name FROM pipeline_runs WHERE repo IN ($repo) ORDER BY workflow_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow)

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conclusion = 'success'))::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow) AND status = 'completed'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow) AND conclusion = 'failure'

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at::timestamptz - started_at::timestamptz))) AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow) AND status = 'completed'

SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at::timestamptz) AS time, COALESCE(conclusion, 'in_progress') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT repo || ' / ' || workflow_name AS workflow, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND conclusion = 'failure' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT started_at::timestamptz AS "Started", repo AS "Repo", workflow_name AS "Workflow", head_branch AS "Branch", head_sha AS "SHA", actor AS "Actor", conclusion AS "Conclusion", html_url AS "URL" FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow) AND conclusion IN ('failure', 'cancelled', 'timed_out') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT repo AS "Repo", workflow_name AS "Workflow", COUNT(*) AS "Runs", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at::timestamptz - started_at::timestamptz)))::numeric, 1) AS "Avg duration (s)", ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conclusion = 'success'))::numeric * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'), 0), 1) AS "Success %" FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repo IN ($repo) AND workflow_name IN ($workflow) AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY "Avg duration (s)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

SELECT l.collected_at::timestamptz AS time, j.repo AS repo, j.name AS job, l.log_text AS body FROM pipeline_logs l JOIN pipeline_jobs j ON j.job_id = l.job_id WHERE j.repo IN ($repo) AND l.collected_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY l.collected_at DESC LIMIT 20
